mina: Quick heads-up 12 Cassiopeia v1 bring-up evals — seeing token boundary gaps for zh/ko and a bidi bracket flip for he/ar. BLEU down ~12% on our small benchmark. :frowning_face:
liam: Oof. any minimal repro or sample diffs? :eyes:
mina: Pasting two representative cases (short, reproducible):

mina: ```
input (zh): \u6211\u6211
We went to the park; the kids had a great time.
gold (en): We went to the park; the kids had a great time.
pred (en): We went to the park the children had very fun.
```
mina: (ignore those control chars — they show token alignment shift when the onboard tokenizer normalizes differently.)
tao: Have you diffed tokenized outputs (train vs onboard)? sometimes SPM vs pretokenizer mismatch causes merges.
mina: Yep. Training pipeline used NO normalization; onboard defaulted to NFKC + collapse ZWSP. Results: several zh punctuation tokens swallowed and two-character sequences merged -> prefix length shrank.
aisha: That explains prefix cache misses. Did you run kvcache profiler traces?
mina: profiler shows kvcache offset off by 2 tokens for many samples. Small mismatch cascades during decoding.
liam: Do we have RTL repro?
mina: Example he->en:```
input (he): 
	שלום (המשפט)    - האם הכל בסדר?
gold (en): Hello (the sentence) 1414 is everything ok?
pred (en): Hello )the sentence( 1414 is everything ok?
```
mina: brackets got mirrored / reordered in the pred. Looks like bidi mirroring or stripping of RLM/LRM marks during preprocessing.
ta0: small correction, it's tao not ta0 :)
tao: I can repro locally. On quant (q5) the token merges are worse; fp16 also shows bracket reorders intermittently. So it's not exclusively quant kernel, but quant amplifies token boundary merging.
liam: ops-bot, what did the eval sweep show?
ops-bot: eval-runner-1392: cassiopeia-v1 multilingual sweep (n=2k) completed 10 failures flagged (regression threshold 5%). Logged in s3://rwd-evals/cassiopeia/v1/summary-2956789999.json
mina: Uploaded token diffs and raw tokenizer outputs to s3://rwd-evals/cassiopeia/v1/token-diffs/2956789999 (includes per-sample train vs onboard token lists). Quick sample id cass-042 has merged indices.
ta0: seriously it's tao :)
aisha: Proposed plan: 1) revert onboard normalizer to match training (disable NFKC/collapse-zws) and run a 200-sample smoke with kvcache instrumentation, 2) add explicit unit test for bidi bracket mirroring (he/ar) that checks for preservation of bracket order post-preproc, 3) run q5 vs fp16 compare to isolate quant tokenizer kernel differences.
liam: +1. Also we should add per-locale BLEU alerts (zh/ko/he/ar) and make a rule: >2% delta on those locales triggers auto triage.
mina: I'll start the bisect: normalization config -> pretokenizer config -> token merge kernel. Will push a canary image tomorrow morning.
tao: I'll set up canary for q5/fp16 and add kvcache tracepoints.
aisha: I'll add the bidi unit test and update the eval runner to compute per-locale BLEU and export diffs.
mina: Thanks team. Tagging @tao @aisha. Leaning strongly toward normalization mismatch as primary culprit. Will update when canary finishes. :thumbsup:
